LanguageData.DMS_Make_FrogmanEmbryo.label: gestate frogman embryo
LanguageData.DMS_Make_FrogmanEmbryo.description: Assemble a directed embryo carrying the XM132 development sequence. The embryo must then be brought to term in a growth vat or implanted into a surrogate. It produces a biomatroid larva, which needs several more days in a gestation pod before it reaches its adult form.
